paras: Sceloporus licki, also known commonly as the Cape arboreal spiny lizard and el bejori arboricola del cabo in Mexican Spanish, is a species of lizard in the family Phrynosomatidae. The species is endemic to the Sierra de la Laguna on the southern Baja California Peninsula in Mexico.
The specific name, licki, is in honor of James Lick, who was an American businessman and philanthropist.
Adults of S. licki have a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 6.3–7.9 cm (2.5–3.1 in).
S. licki is found in the Mexican State of Baja California Sur.
The preferred natural habitats of S. licki are forest and shrubland.
